Based on the service status, the pgbouncer instance in the prod environment is in a "pool_exhausted" state. There are 100 connections currently in use, which equals the maximum capacity of the pool. This state indicates that the pool has no available slots for new connections, which is contributing to the elevated latency and client errors. The stalled sessions lack a client-side timeout, so the pool will not clear itself without intervention. The current error rate is at 41% and increasing, affecting checkout requests. 

Given the observed symptoms, the recommended next step is to terminate the existing client-side sessions to free up slots in the pool, allowing it to recover. This will help reduce the error rate and address the current issue.

<tool_call>
{"name": "terminate_sessions", "arguments": {"namespace": "prod", "service": "pgbouncer"}}
</tool_call>
